component.name: Luxafor Status
component.summary: Control a Luxafor status light from your desktop

description.p: Set the color of a Luxafor USB status light (ORB, Flag) from a dock launcher, a system tray icon that shows the current status, or the command line.
Statuses are configurable: as many as you like, with your own names and colors. A small panel sets one for a while — busy for 30 minutes, then back to available.
During calls in your web browser (Teams, Odoo, Meet…), the light can switch to a status of your choice automatically.
